header: What the platform is rated for
lead: The numbers below are contractual for the standard plan. Where a limit is soft we say so rather than quietly raising it later.
note: Figures apply per organisation. Sites on the enterprise plan are rated separately and the values are named in the contract.

rows.title: Rota history retained

rows.title: Availability commitment
